title: Fix Pre-deploy Bugs
bottom_line: Run it after you mark bugs Fix or Skip on the bug review page. Each bug marked Fix becomes its own merged pull request.

sections.heading: Run it after choosing Fix or Skip on the page

blocks.caption: With no URL it uses the page from the last /pre-deploy-tests:run in this repository.

blocks.text: It needs the `plan-tools` and `model-picker` plugins, which install with this one, `gh` signed in, and auto-merge allowed in the repository. It commits, pushes, opens pull requests and enables auto-merge without asking again.

blocks.title: What it asks before starting
rows: Fix the bugs nobody marked Fix or Skip?
Highest model a fix may use (asked every run)
How to start the app locally (only after a run on an integration environment, since a fix is proven on a local app)
No default: you give the commands once

sections.heading: Each bug becomes one pull request

nodes.label: Reproduce
nodes.note: From the bug's steps or its reproduction script.

nodes.label: Fix and re-check
nodes.note: The same reproduction must now give the expected result. UI bugs get an "after" capture.

blocks.text: Bugs go by severity, Blocker first, then by number. The next bug starts only after the previous PR merges, so every fix builds on the ones before it.

sections.heading: Follow progress on the bug review page

cards.title: Fixed
cards.text: The card shows the PR link and the "after" capture next to the "before" one.

cards.title: Could not reproduce
cards.text: No code changed. The card says what was tried.

cards.title: Needs attention
cards.text: Checks failed three times, auto-merge is off, or the PR waits on a review. The card says why; the run goes on to the next bug.

blocks.text: Run it again to retry bugs that could not be reproduced or need attention. Bugs marked Skip are never touched.

next_action.text: Mark each bug Fix or Skip on the page, then run `/pre-deploy-tests:fix`.
next_action.detail: The final report lists each fixed bug with its PR, and the ones not reproduced or needing attention.
